entries.title: Kids Keva Club for ages 5 and up
entries.description: Practice your artistic and architectural skills without tools, glue, nails, or tape - just planks!
entries.priorTitleZh: 5 岁及以上儿童 KEVA 搭建俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 喜欢 LEGO 积木的孩子可以自由发挥创意进行搭建。

entries.title: Saturday Board Games Day
entries.description: The group meets every 1st Saturday from 10 AM–6 PM.nbsp;\nAttendees can bring their own games to play or jump-in with others.
entries.priorTitleZh: 周六桌游日
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 参与者可以自带桌游，也可以加入其他人的游戏。

entries.title: Baby Sign and Stay and Play
entries.description: Calling all non-walking babies ages 0-12 months for a special storytime featuring American Sign Language along with songs and stories and fun!
entries.priorTitleZh: 宝宝手语与自由玩耍
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎宝宝和家长或照护者一起交流互动。上午 10:30–11:00 为故事时间，11:00–12:00 为自由玩耍。感谢 Los Altos Friends of the Library 对活动的支持。

entries.title: Family BINGO
entries.description: nbsp;We will be running multiple rounds, so you can drop in and play anytime.
entries.priorTitleZh: 家庭 BINGO 宾果游戏
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 活动将进行多轮，欢迎随时到场参与。

entries.title: Holiday Jazz Music
entries.description: Join us for MAK Band Jazz, a special sing-along performance of holiday favorites.\nThis band is an ensemble featuring guitar, ukulele, trumpet, tenor saxophone, alto saxophone, clarinet, trombone, bass, drums, harmonica and percussion, along with special guest jazz musicians.They will perform popular holiday music, including songs such as "Jingle Bells," "Frosty the Snowman," "Let It Snow," “Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree,” and others.\nThis is a family program.
entries.priorTitleZh: 节日爵士音乐
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 将演奏热门节日歌曲，包括《Jingle Bells》《Frosty the Snowman》《Let It Snow》《Rockin’ Around the Christmas Tree》等。

entries.title: Baby Sign and Sing
entries.description: Join us for Sign and Sing for Babies in our first floor program room!
entries.priorTitleZh: 宝宝手语与歌唱
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 成年照护者将学习与宝宝沟通的基本手语。

entries.title: Winter Magic Show with Magician Mike Della Penna
entries.description: Come warm yourself this season with a little fun and a whole lot of wonder at anbsp;magic show inspired by the most magical season of the year, a time of shorter days, colder nights, and annual celebrations of light!
entries.priorTitleZh: 魔术师 Mike Della Penna 冬季魔术秀
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这场魔术秀以白昼渐短、夜晚转冷和一年一度灯光庆典的冬季为灵感，带来欢乐与惊奇。

entries.title: Domingos de Matiné con merienda
entries.description: After the movie, there will be a brief discussion about the movie’s history, its making and themes.\nThere will be snacks to enjoy with the movie!
entries.priorTitleZh: 周日电影与点心（Domingos de Matiné con merienda）
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 电影结束后，将简短讨论影片的历史、制作过程和主题。

entries.title: LEGO Club for Grades K-8
entries.description: Children will use their creativity and engineering skills to free build anything they can imagine.\nThis is a drop-in program.
entries.priorTitleZh: K–8 年级 LEGO 积木俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子们将运用创造力和工程技能，自由搭建想象中的作品。

entries.title: Growing Readers: Help Your Aspiring Writer
entries.description: A freenbsp;workshop for parents and caregivers presented by Santa Clara County Office of Education and The Reading Program of Santa Clara County Library District.nbsp;\nHelp your child gain confidence as a writer.
entries.priorTitleZh: 培养阅读者：帮助有写作兴趣的孩子
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 面向家长和照护者的免费工作坊，由 Santa Clara County Office of Education 和 Santa Clara County Library District 的 The Reading Program 举办。

entries.title: Library Ukulele Society of Morgan Hill
entries.description: Bring your uke and music stand or come to listen and sing along.
entries.priorTitleZh: Morgan Hill 图书馆尤克里里社团
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 学习歌曲并一起演奏。

entries.title: Story Explorers: TK-1st Grade Book Club
entries.description: Attendees are not expected to read the book ahead of time.nbsp;We'll read together, havenbsp;a short discussion of each book, move to music, and end with a fun craft!
entries.priorTitleZh: 故事探索者：TK–1 年级读书会
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 大家将一起阅读、简短讨论每本书、跟着音乐活动，并以趣味手工结束。

entries.title: Virtual Author Talk: Robin Ha
entries.description: If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
entries.priorTitleZh: 线上作家讲座：Robin Ha
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这本书采用漫画风格的食谱，介绍简单步骤、实用技巧和美味菜肴，让初学者和有经验的厨师都能以有趣的方式在家学习韩国料理。

entries.title: Poetry in the Dark
entries.description: This December, join us for a dimly lit evening of shared poetry at the Cupertino Library.nbsp;Voices of all ages, cultures, and languages come together to share the power of the spoken and written word.nbsp;Each participant may read their poem(s) aloud to their group.nbsp;Hosted by Thomas Célérier - Cupertino Poet LaureateAll are welcome.No prior experience necessary.
entries.priorTitleZh: 黑暗中的诗歌
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎聚在一起用心聆听，欣赏差异，并致敬塑造我们社区的多种语言。

entries.title: Lil' Athletes for Ages 18 Months - 4 Years
entries.description: Stories, stretches, and sports-themed activities for tots on the move!

entries.title: LEGO Club
entries.description: Children can follow our prompts ornbsp;build based on their imagination.nbsp;\nnbsp;El Lego Club en la Biblioteca de Gilroy se reúne el segndo viernesnbsp;de cadanbsp;mes.\nNosotros proporcionamos los legos, los niños construyen creaciones divertidas!

entries.title: Cozy Creators
entries.description: Come hang out with us and get crafting!
entries.priorTitleZh: 温馨手工创作
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子们可以制作美丽的季节主题作品，而闪亮的手工材料会留在图书馆，不会散落在家中。

entries.title: Safe Space meeting for LGBTQ+ youth ages 13-25
entries.description: Our staff led meetings offer a safe space for youth to: play games, participate in group activities discussions, and build community.

entries.title: Miss Molly Bubbles
entries.description: This captivating performance will fill your eyes with wonder and laughter, creating a magical experience for all ages.Due to limited space, we will start handing out free tickets 30 minutes before this event.
entries.priorTitleZh: Miss Molly Bubbles 泡泡表演
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这场引人入胜的表演将带来惊奇与欢笑，让各年龄段观众体验奇妙时刻。

entries.title: Tiny Toots Concert: Farmer Arann
entries.description: \nFarmer Arann will be here with his instruments, big voice, unique songs, and super fun personality!
entries.priorTitleZh: Tiny Toots 音乐会：Farmer Arann
entries.priorDescriptionZh: Farmer Arann 将带着乐器、洪亮的歌声、独特的歌曲和活泼有趣的风格来到现场。

entries.title: Adult & Teen Crafternoon: Felted Snowmen
entries.description: Any demonstrations will take place at the start of the program at 3 PM, though there will be instructions and staff to answer questions at any time.December's craft is Felted Snowmen!
entries.priorTitleZh: 成人与青少年手工下午：羊毛毡雪人
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 学习针毡基础技法，制作冬日作品；初学者可做简单的雪人，想尝试更多变化的人也可制作更复杂的雪地动物。

entries.title: Merry Pixie Pages
entries.description: Every rhyme, song, and story helps build the skills kids need to become confident readers.\nCome tonbsp;Merry Pixie Pages, where the love of reading begins!
entries.priorTitleZh: 欢乐精灵故事时间（Merry Pixie Pages）
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 每首童谣、歌曲和故事都有助于孩子培养成为自信读者所需的技能。

entries.title: A Look into the Night Sky with Astro Everywhere
entries.description: \nWe’ll gather in the Treetop Room for a live astronomy show featuring planetarium software to explore the night sky as seen from Palo Alto.
entries.priorTitleZh: 与 Astro Everywhere 一起探索夜空
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 大家将在 Treetop Room 观看现场天文演示，使用天文馆软件探索从 Palo Alto 看到的夜空。

entries.title: Tiny Toots Concert: House Of Samba Kids
entries.description: If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

entries.title: The San Jose Nutcracker
entries.description: Attendees will enjoy opportunities to interact with costumed characters and be photographed in magical fairytale settings, plus enjoy treats and toys available for purchase.
